name: Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant
description: An OAuth 2.0 extension that enables secure identity assertion delegation using JWT tokens. Allows agents to obtain access tokens by presenting identity assertions from trusted identity providers.

name: Agent-to-Agent Protocol
description: Google's protocol for direct communication between AI agents. Defines standardized message formats, discovery mechanisms, and authentication patterns for agent-to-agent interactions.

name: Model Context Protocol
description: Anthropic's protocol for connecting AI models to external tools and data sources. Provides a standardized way for LLMs to interact with resources, tools, and prompts through a unified interface.

name: Agent Identity Management System
description: A framework for managing AI agent identities, including registration, authentication, and lifecycle management. Addresses unique challenges of non-human identity in distributed systems.

name: Secure Production Identity Framework For Everyone
description: A set of standards for securely identifying and authenticating workloads in dynamic and heterogeneous environments. Provides cryptographically verifiable identity through SVIDs (SPIFFE Verifiable Identity Documents).

name: Workload Identity in Multi-System Environments
description: IETF working group developing standards for workload identity that work across different platforms, cloud providers, and trust domains. Focuses on interoperability and federation.

name: OpenAI Function Calling
description: A specification for defining functions that LLMs can call during inference. Enables structured output generation and tool use through JSON Schema-based function definitions.

name: AAuth Protocol
description: Authentication and authorization protocol for AI agents. Provides cryptographic identity for HTTP clients with four access modes, supporting identity-based access through federated authorization.
